-- C05: every rate is within 15% of its trailing 30-day median (current row and 29 preceding days).
with windowed as (
    select
        currency,
        rate_date,
        rate_to_usd,
        median(rate_to_usd) over (partition by currency order by rate_date rows between 29 preceding and current row) as trailing_window
    from "warehouse"."staging"."stg_fx_rates"
),

medians as (
    select
        currency,
        rate_date,
        rate_to_usd,
        trailing_window as trailing_median
    from windowed
)

select
    currency,
    rate_date,
    rate_to_usd,
    trailing_median
from medians
where abs(rate_to_usd - trailing_median) > 0.15 * trailing_median

group by currency, rate_date

-- C03: no non-USD currency repeats the same rate on more than 3 consecutive days (a stale feed).
with flagged as (
    select
        currency,
        rate_date,
        rate_to_usd,
        case
            when rate_to_usd = lag(rate_to_usd) over (partition by currency order by rate_date) then 0
            else 1
        end as starts_run
    from "warehouse"."staging"."stg_fx_rates"
    where currency <> 'USD'
),

runs as (
    select
        currency,
        rate_date,
        sum(starts_run) over (
            partition by currency order by rate_date rows between unbounded preceding and current row
        ) as run_id
    from flagged
)

select
    currency,
    run_id,
    min(rate_date) as run_start,
    count(*) as run_days
from runs
group by currency, run_id
having count(*) > 3

where (o.next_valid_from is not null and (o.valid_to is null or o.valid_to <> o.next_valid_from))

-- S02: consecutive stages of an application (in time order) are an allowed transition.
with ordered as (
    select
        application_id,
        stage,
        lead(stage) over (partition by application_id order by entered_at, event_id) as next_stage
    from "warehouse"."staging"."stg_stage_events"
)

select
    application_id,
    stage,
    next_stage
from ordered
where next_stage is not null
    and concat(stage, '>', next_stage) not in (
        'applied>screen', 'applied>rejected', 'applied>withdrawn',
        'screen>onsite', 'screen>rejected', 'screen>withdrawn',
        'onsite>offer', 'onsite>rejected', 'onsite>withdrawn',
        'offer>hired', 'offer>declined', 'offer>withdrawn'
    )

-- S03: in canonical stage order, stage timestamps never go backwards within an application.
with ordered as (
    select
        application_id,
        stage,
        stage_order,
        entered_at,

    from "warehouse"."staging"."stg_stage_events"
)

from ordered
where prev_entered_at is not null

with ordered as (

    select

    from "warehouse"."staging"."stg_stage_events"
    where source_system = 'recruiter_tool'
)

    sum(case when local_hour >= 7 and local_hour < 21 then 1 else 0 end) as n_in_hours
from events
group by location_id
having sum(case when local_hour >= 7 and local_hour < 21 then 1 else 0 end) < 0.98 * count(*)

having count(*) > 1

select
    department_id,
    hire_month,
    count(*) as hires,
    cast(case when (count(*)) = 0 then null else (cast(sum(days_to_hire) as decimal(38,9))) / (count(*)) end as decimal(38,9)) as avg_days_to_hire
from "warehouse"."marts"."fct_hires"
group by department_id, hire_month

select
    department_id,
    hire_month,
    count(*) as hires
from "warehouse"."marts"."fct_hires"
group by department_id, hire_month

-- X04: three-way reconciliation per month: hires metric = fct_hires rows = HRIS hired events.
-- Every side buckets by the LOCAL hire date; a UTC bucket would move 1st-of-month hires east of UTC
-- into the previous month (SPEC 6.4).
with metric as (
    select
        hire_month as month_start,
        sum(hires) as metric_hires
    from "warehouse"."marts"."metric_hires_monthly"
    group by hire_month
),

facts as (
    select
        hire_month as month_start,
        count(*) as fact_hires
    from "warehouse"."marts"."fct_hires"
    group by hire_month
),

events as (
    select
        cast(date_trunc('month', event_local_date) as date) as month_start,
        count(*) as hired_events
    from "warehouse"."staging"."stg_stage_events"
    where stage = 'hired'
    group by cast(date_trunc('month', event_local_date) as date)
)

select
    coalesce(m.month_start, f.month_start, e.month_start) as month_start,
    m.metric_hires,
    f.fact_hires,
    e.hired_events
from metric as m
full outer join facts as f
    on f.month_start = m.month_start
full outer join events as e
    on e.month_start = coalesce(m.month_start, f.month_start)
where coalesce(m.metric_hires, -1) <> coalesce(f.fact_hires, -1)
    or coalesce(f.fact_hires, -1) <> coalesce(e.hired_events, -1)
